records.text: :tada: New signup: *Union Group* just joined on the pro plan!

decisions.rationale: Six days in with zero customer replies to two outreach emails (email:2d0efdc5, email:14be7a86), no project, no invite, no tickets, and no signal of engagement. Silent accounts rarely self-activate in the remaining 8 days, though the active Pro subscription leaves some chance.

draft.subject: Getting Union Group's first project going
draft.body:
Hi Ana,

I know a new tool can be easy to put off in a busy week, so no worries if Wrenfield has been on the back burner.

When you're ready, the quickest first step is setting up one real project 
dash; projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them. From there, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to work through that first project with you live, or answer anything over email if that's easier.

Best,
Priya
